item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01180","case1_error":"Uses living alone in the new apartment as the baseline; the intended baseline may instead be the old apartment.","case2_error":"Subtracts the $2 substitution price increase instead of adding it, producing $31 instead of $35.","reason":"The living-alone baseline is materially ambiguous, and the first solution is correct under its interpretation. The second clearly reverses the price adjustment.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01181","case1_error":"Uses acquisition cost per egg instead of selling price to determine how many sales recover the investment.","case2_error":"Adds dead chickens to purchased chickens instead of adding surviving chickens.","reason":"Both substitute a related but incorrect quantity into the required calculation: acquisition cost for sale proceeds, and deaths for surviving stock.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01182","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 22 minus 7/3 as 22 2/3 and leaves the answer in yards instead of requested feet.","case2_error":"Incorrectly equates one-sixth of a day with 24 hours, ignoring the fractional duration.","reason":"The first miscalculates a correctly written subtraction and fails to convert the answer; the second states an incorrect time-conversion relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01183","case1_error":"Equates current practice with past practice, asserts P = 2P, and unjustifiably concludes x = 2.","case2_error":"Omits the initial $10,000 purchase from total spending when subtracting resale proceeds.","reason":"The first uses contradictory equations and an unsupported inference; the second omits an expenditure from the net-cost calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01184","case1_error":"Models five child tickets and five adult tickets instead of three child tickets and two adult tickets.","case2_error":"Reports the correctly written sum 6 + 8 + 4 + 12 as “2L” instead of 30.","reason":"The first constructs an incorrect cost equation; the second gives an invalid evaluation of an otherwise correct total expression.","judgment":"different"}]}
